water.note: SM64 water boxes = LANDMARKS water_boxes_m; Mario walks where the water is < 0.8 m deep (the bank and shelf), swims elsewhere

north_shallows.from: the west bog's east tip (north boardwalk -> wade onto the west bog -> walk it east)
north_shallows.note: game_design 7.4 act 1 Boardwalk Welcome: 15 pads over 2-2.5 m of water from the west bog to the open centre (a rest pad half way, a big end pad); edge gaps widen from 1.3 to 2.4 m (run-up hops); a miss = swim to a pad and climb on (pads have no side walls)

east_marsh.note: marsh pads from wading depth out over the east basin's deep hole

south_arm.note: pads between the bald cypress of the south-west arm (red coins, a cypress knee)

items.name: field coins by the bat barns

nest.note: gator nest mound (mud + sticks, three eggs) on the small bog: the "island nest" of design acts 2 and 5 (the bog uf_lake_missions.lua uses); the mother gator goes beside it
